integrity: Proof is exact rational matrix algebra. The independent audit channel has not been performed. The standalone verifier uses exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted complete multipartite graphs with r>=3, all part sizes>=2, nonuniform part sizes and exactly two noise-free leaders.
Does not treat singleton parts, other budgets, heterogeneous noise, or variable edge conductances.
Originality assessed on inspected sources and search; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Two noise-free leaders on unequal complete multipartite networks obey a smallest-part law
